summary: Float-conversion rounding helper. Given a status word a1 and an in-register float result, conditionally applies a +1.0 compensation when the 0x80000 status bit is clear; returns the value unchanged when the bit is set. The legacy ABI label identifies it as a rounding-mode select driven by the x87 status word, consistent with the bit test.

operations.description: Test the status bit: when (a1 & 0x80000) == 0 the compensated value is returned, otherwise the input value is returned unchanged.
Compute the compensated value result + 1.0; the packet global dbl_5B8E00 is read and is the source of the 1.0 literal folded into this expression.
Return result + 1.0 when the 0x80000 status bit is clear.
Return result unchanged when the 0x80000 status bit is set.
Invoked by sub_58858D (0x0058858D) and sub_5894BD (0x005894BD) as a rounding-mode/float-conversion helper on the frame path.

unresolved: The mapping of global dbl_5B8E00 to the +1.0 literal is inferred from the read flag and the expression; the literal itself appears inline in the raw source.
The exact status-word semantics of the 0x80000 bit (and how callers derive a1) are caller context, not documented in this function.
